caption:
Swipe to see a VC build a full wedding website with GPT-6 in under 6 minutes, and what 66,000 people figured out the second they watched it 💸

Justine Moore opened GPT-6 Astra Max, described her wedding, a complete website appeared in 5 minutes and 59 seconds with no edits or cuts, she posted the entire session unedited for anyone to watch and copy, 356,000 people watched it, 66,700 liked it in under 24 hours, 771 people reposted it the same day, those likes were not applause but 66,000 people calculating what they had already paid for the same result, and Moore is a venture capitalist whose job is to fund software companies, making her the last person you would expect to publicly show 356,000 people how to skip all of them

GPT-6 didn't speed up web design. It removed the reason to pay for it. Every platform that charged couples for a complicated process now competes with a six-minute conversation.

Running a business? DM us "AI" and we'll show you what GPT-6 could replace in yours.
